scope: Follow-up on existing shared profiles. Exact comparison-region baseline required for production validation. Stored scan poses are comparison-only; no per-card rendering offsets.
limitations: Identity proposals retain the prior placement; they do not certify perfect glyph shape.
Low-confidence frame normalization, missing assets and reserved regressions stay in review.
Rarity material differences and special layouts remain separate reviews.
